notes: ARMSX2 (PlayStation 2): the upstream Linux arm64 4K-pages AppImage, mounted; its real binary is run, never AppRun.
-batch quits when the game closes, so OpenGamepadUI gets the panel back; -nogui keeps the desktop main window from opening behind the game; -- ends options.
gui_args: Big Picture, the pad-driven UI; no -batch, which would quit at once with no game.
ARMSX2 keeps its settings in ~/.config/ARMSX2/inis/PCSX2.ini (the seed must carry [UI] SettingsVersion = 1).

gamepad_profile guide-hotkeys.yaml: hold Guide for L1 load state, R1 save state (slot 1), R2 fast-forward (HoldTurbo), Start quit — as keyboard F1-F4, bound in the seeded PCSX2.ini [Hotkeys] (LoadStateFromSlot1, SaveStateToSlot1, HoldTurbo, ShutdownVM). ShutdownVM is the pause menu's shut down: resume state and memory cards written, and -batch quits the app. Select + Start (pause menu) stays.

achievements: the player's one RetroAchievements sign-in and Hardcore toggle, written at every launch (plan standalone-cheevos): Enabled, ChallengeMode, Username in PCSX2.ini [Achievements], the token in inis/secrets.ini where PCSX2 keeps it. A Token in PCSX2.ini is removed: PCSX2 would move it over ours into secrets.ini at start.
